paragraphs: This section will outline the applications for the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller, focusing on its GPIO, ADC, Timers, and UART peripherals. The microcontroller is equipped with a Soil Moisture Sensor Analog Out connected to PA0, an Onboard Status LED connected to PC13, and USART1_TX and USART1_RX for serial communication.
bullets: The Soil Moisture Sensor Analog Out allows the system to measure soil moisture levels using an ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter). This data can be used to adjust irrigation schedules or monitor plant health.

The Onboard Status LED connected to PC13 provides a visual alert when an action is needed, such as when a sensor detects a high moisture level. This feature enhances user interaction and system responsiveness.

USART1_TX and USART1_RX allow the system to communicate with other devices over serial, enabling data transmission for telemetry and debugging purposes. The baud rate of 115200 ensures efficient communication at a moderate speed.
